visualDescription.sceneDescriptionEn: A black and white engraving depicting two men standing on a rocky outcrop near a riverbank in a wooded area. One man, dressed in fringed buckskin clothing and a fur cap, holds a long rifle and places his hand on the shoulder of the other man. The second man is depicted with a lean build, wearing a loincloth and a feathered headdress, standing with his back to the viewer and looking toward the forest. The style is that of a 19th-century book illustration.

suggestedMatch.exactSourceQuotation: While one of these loiterers showed the red skin and wild accoutrements of a native of the woods, the other exhibited, through the mask of his rude and nearly savage equipments, the brighter, though sunburnt and long-faded complexion of one who might claim descent from a European parentage.

In contrast, the engraving depicts two men standing upright on a rocky outcrop, with one touching the other's shoulder, corresponding to a different event in the novel rather than the text provided.
